title: Moose vs. EC3: destroy the past
summary: Returning EC3 targets Moose’s attachment to the old TNA championship belt. Their psychological feud pushes Moose to become the ruthless figure EC3 insists is hiding beneath his self-proclaimed champion status.

chapters.title: EC3 targets Moose
chapters.result: EC3 attacks Moose after his return to Impact.
chapters.context: The returning former champion challenges Moose’s relationship with TNA’s past, setting up a conflict about identity as much as possession of a belt.

chapters.title: The undisclosed-location confrontation
chapters.result: Moose overpowers EC3 in their cinematic fight.
chapters.context: EC3 goads Moose into embracing his aggression. Moose leaves standing after the violent encounter, advancing his transformation without a conventional arena championship match.
